description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח מכלול - ציוד אלקטרוני
description.summary: This table details the basis for determining the sum insured for electronic equipment under the 'Mecholal' insurance policy. It outlines how replacement costs are calculated, including transport, setup, and taxes.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתייחסת לתנאי פוליסת ביטוח מכלול, ספציפית לציוד אלקטרוני, ומסבירה כיצד מחושב סכום הביטוח במקרה של נזק או אובדן. החישוב מבוסס על עלות החלפה של הרכוש המבוטח ברכוש חדש מאותו סוג ובעל אותה יכולת תפוקה, כולל הוצאות הובלה, התקנה, מיסים והיטלים. במקרה שאין רכוש חדש זהה בשוק, סכום הביטוח יהיה המחיר האחרון שנקבע לרכוש המבוטח כחדש על ידי נציג מורשה של היצרן בישראל. תנאים אלו אינם חלים על הכיסויים הנוספים המפורטים בסעיפים 4.1 ו-4.2, כגון שחזור נתונים ותוכנה והוצאות תפעול נוספות. Mecholal ביטוח לעסק מציע פתרונות מותאמים.
description.column_axis: Basis for determining the sum insured
notable_values: Alternative cost: last price by authorized manufacturer

sketch:
5. Special conditions for Chapter Four
5.1 The basis for determining the sum insured
The sum insured for electronic equipment shall be the cost of replacing the insured property with a new property of the same type and with the same output capacity. This cost includes: transport fees, set-up costs, levies and taxes (if applicable). In the event that there is no new property on the market which is identical to the insured property, the sum insured will be the last price determined for the insured property - as new - by the authorized manufacturer's representative in Israel.
Whatsoever appearing in this condition shall not apply with the additional covers listed in paragraphs 4.1 and 4.2 above (cover for data and software restoration as well as cover for additional operating expenses, respectively), in respect of which whatsoever appearing in paragraphs 4.1.5.1 and 4.2.6.1 respectively shall apply (on a first loss basis).

This table details the basis for determining the sum insured for electronic equipment under the 'Mecholal' insurance policy. It outlines how replacement costs are calculated, including transport, setup, and taxes.
ממדים: Special conditions for Chapter Four, Basis for determining the sum insured

5. Special conditions for Chapter Four
5.1 The basis for determining the sum insured
The sum insured for electronic equipment shall be the cost of replacing the insured property with a new property of the same type and with the same output capacity. This cost includes: transport fees, set-up costs, levies and taxes (if applicable). In the event that there is no new property on the market which is identical to the insured property, the sum insured will be the last price determined for the insured property - as new - by the authorized manufacturer's representative in Israel.
Whatsoever appearing in this condition shall not apply with the additional covers listed in paragraphs 4.1 and 4.2 above (cover for data and software restoration as well as cover for additional operating expenses, respectively), in respect of which whatsoever appearing in paragraphs 4.1.5.1 and 4.2.6.1 respectively shall apply (on a first loss basis).
